No. 1941/35 – FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 20, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. 4/2/1/80. Land Ministry Reference No. 4-3/7/2012/HW/395.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land to be Acquired:

Lot No. 1 to 17 allotments below name land in total extent of about 0.0524, shown in Preliminary Plan No. Gam. 3962 and dated 16.10.2015, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Gampaha District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the villages of Pugoda and Meniklanda in the Grama Niladari Division of No. 422, Pugoda and 422-A, Meniklanda in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Dompe, in the District of Gampaha in Western Province.
1. Lot No. 1 Name of land: Weralugas Owita; Descrption: Garden; Claiment: State; Original Claimant: Indrani Jayasiri Menike, No. 61/D/6, Kalugasinna, Pugoda; Extent: 0.0013 Hectare.

2. Lot No. 2 Name of land: Weralugas Owita; Descrption: Garden, contains a part of temporary building; Claiment: State; Original Claimant: Hewaralalage Dharmapala, No. 75, Pattiyagama, Pugoda; Extent: 0.0082 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Dompe on the 18th day of January 2016, at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 11th day of January, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
H. G. J. P. WIJAYASIRIWARDENA, Divisional Secretary, Dompe.
